eval2_distinct_split.instructions: Does the shown runner treat eval2 as its own split with separate metrics rather than merging it into tuning or eval?

criteria.true: eval2 has its own metric block computed from its own cases
criteria.false: eval2 is merged into another split or not separated

eval2_labels_structured.instructions: Do the shown eval2 case definitions carry an expected status, expected rules, allowed alternatives, an evidence pointer, a split, and a rationale, as the base corpus does?

criteria.true: All of those label fields are present for eval2 cases
criteria.false: At least one label field is missing for eval2 cases

rule_set_digest_recorded.instructions: Does the shown screening report include a content digest of the rule pack that built its diagnostics?

criteria.true: The report carries a rule pack content digest
criteria.false: No rule pack digest is recorded

expected_rule_applicability_checked.instructions: Does the shown validator check that each defect case expected rule actually applies to the question of that case?

criteria.true: The validator rejects a defect case whose expected rule does not apply
criteria.false: The validator does not perform that check

sufficiency_split_metrics_shown.instructions: Do the shown materials show how the per-split metrics are computed, without relying on code that is not shown?

criteria.true: The metric computation and split selection are fully shown
criteria.false: Part of the metric computation or split selection is absent
